text:
Samir (oncall): Heads-up — I'm handing off the evening shift. brief recap: we had a target-region 503 spike earlier (EUC-alloc) but mitigation succeeded. leaving a few watch items.

Samir (oncall): Primary/secondary: I'm primary for next 2h, @Lina you'll be secondary from 23:30 UTC. If pager hits, Lina takes incident lead after I sign out.

Lina (secondary): ack — I'll be pingable on phone and slack. LMK any open pages or playbook pointers.

Samir (oncall): Pages in the last 3 hours: 1) region-euc allocation throttles causing 503s -> autoscaler fixed by bumping reserved pods; 2) embedding-encoder OOM on a single host, pod restarted and evicted cache. Both resolved but follow-ups below.

ops-bot: Incident summary (auto): Pager #4221 region-euc 503 surge, start 1955549000, end 1955550800. Impact: ~2% of requests + increased latency p95. Action: autoscale reserve -> rollout stable.

Jordan: For the embedding-encoder OOM, logs showed continuous batch size growth when client sent long sequences. Raised PR to clamp batch sizes: https://git.internal/r/enc-clamp-PR123. CI green.

Samir (oncall): Follow-ups before handoff:
- Add pod resource guard for embedding-encoder (Jordan PR) — needs one more review and deploy to canary.
- Eviction monitoring: increase alert threshold for host memory evictions; runbook link below.
- Confirm autoscaler steady state in EUC for next 24h.

Priya: I updated the runbook quicknote: /runbooks/eviction-and-oom.md (line 42) with temporary throttle rules. Also added the K8s mem pressure query used during the spike.

Samir (oncall): Runbook snippets I'll leave:
- k8s query: kubectl -n inference top nodes | sort -r -k3\- check host mem > 85% -> consider draining noncritical pools.
- Eviction check: grafana dashboard /d/evictions -> set alert to 4/min for 5m before paging.

Lina (secondary): Do we have a fallback model for EUC if autoscaler fails?

Samir (oncall): Yes — we have a routing policy that falls back to ms-euc-compact (lower-cost quantized variant). It's configured in routing-v2 policy: fallback -> ms-euc-compact. If traffic to fallback goes >10% for 10m, page infra-sre.

deploy-bot: Deployment started: cluster: euc-canary, manifest: embedding-encoder:v2.1-clamp, started at 1955555200.

Jordan: Canary looks fine so far (30m). CPU and memory stable in canary. No tail latencies.

Samir (oncall): Known coverage gaps:
- Night hours: where both primary and secondary are in different timezones, we sometimes have 20–30m delay during pager escalation to on-call backup.
- On-call backup rotation isn't always in calendar; reminder to ops leads to keep rotation updated.

Priya: Suggestion: add a secondary-auto-escalation step: if pager unanswered for 10m, escalate to oncall-backup group + send SMS. We have a short doc for this. I can open a ticket.

Lina (secondary): +1 to auto-escalation. Also, can we get an ephemeral alert that shows which model variant is in fallback currently? Makes customer-impact calls easier.

Samir (oncall): Next steps for Lina (before I sign off):
1) Watch EUC autoscaler for next 60m. If you see >1% 503s reappear for 5m, initiate failover to fallback routing and page infra-sre.
2) After deploy completes, verify embedding-encoder pod restart rate = 0 for 30m.
3) If eviction alerts trigger, follow runbook: drain noncritical pools -> increase reserved capacity -> contact infra.

Lina (secondary): Got it. I'll monitor and post a short status update in this thread at 1955556000 and 1955557600.

Samir (oncall): Customer impact: only a handful of sessions had degraded responses; we informed support to flag any escalations. No major customers reported errors yet.

Jordan: I've added a dashboard panel to show routing fallback percentage: panel id 47 on /d/routing. It will help track Lina's step 1.

ops-bot: Reminder: daily oncall checklist - health checks, incident inbox, escalations, runbook updates.

Priya: FYI I opened TKT-4527 to formalize the secondary auto-escalation. Assigning to @Lina for review.

Lina (secondary): Reviewed the embedding canary logs. No anomalies. Starting the 60m watch now. I'll update here at the two checkpoints.

Samir (oncall): Thank you all — I'll be offline after 23:30 UTC. Lina will take incident lead after that. Leaving my pager muted but reachable for 10m for urgent handover. :wave:

Lina (secondary): signed in. Watching. If anything, I'll escalate to infra-sre and page @oncall-backup after 10m unanswered.

Priya: Noted. Closing loop: update runbook after Jordan's PR merges and we confirm canary.

Samir (oncall): Handing off now — good luck, team.

Lina (secondary): copy. updates: 1955556000 = all stable. 1955557600 = still stable, no regressions.

ops-bot: Auto-note: handoff completed 1955557800.
